plan.notes: Source: TMCC official catalog 'Early Childhood Education, AA' (https://catalog.tmcc.edu/degrees-certificates/early-childhood-education-aa/), 'Recommended Course Schedule' plan-of-study grid (Early Childhood Education Career Map), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02. Grid rows shown only as a footnote number with units (5, 6) do not name a specific course in the published schedule and are not defined on this page — modeled as choice slots with the catalog's footnote number preserved in choice_note; see advisor. Students must earn a C or better in each degree and emphasis requirement. All ECE degrees require field/practicum experience: fingerprints, approved background check, and clear TB test required before enrolling in field-experience courses; practicum must be completed through TMCC. The catalog states the AA in Early Childhood Education is accredited by NAEYC's Commission on the Accreditation of Early Childhood Higher Education Programs (accreditation term stated as July 2023 through July 2025). Per-course prerequisites are not listed in the schedule grid. This program can be completed online but may require in-person assignments or exams.
